backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and per‑game stats with access‑controlled queries and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing UI/UX changes, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file's purpose across UI, games, hooks, and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base file defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode values, and global style resets.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level view router switching between Home and four game screens.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states.
frontend/src/components/home/QuickPlayMe: Quick Play grid of four game buttons with icons and themed styling.
frontend/src/components/stats/StatsSumma: Stats card showing per‑game plays, wins, and win rate with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/games/carrom/CarromBoardCan: Canvas renderer for carrom board, pockets, coins, striker, and aiming line based on game state.
Implements carrom board physics including coin initialization, movement, collisions, pockets, and scoring logic.
frontend/src/games/carrom/CarromScreen.t: UI for starting and playing a carrom game, handling shots, animations, and updating user stats when the match ends.
frontend/src/games/chess/ChessBoard.tsx: Renders the chessboard grid and pieces, handling visual selection and click events.
frontend/src/games/chess/chessRules.ts: Defines chess rules, board initialization, move validation, path checking, check and checkmate detection, and move execution.
frontend/src/games/chess/ChessScreen.tsx: Main chess gameplay UI managing move logic, game state transitions, resigning, and stat updates.
frontend/src/games/cricket/cricketEngine: Implements a seeded cricket match simulator with innings handling, ball-by-ball outcomes, and winner determination.
frontend/src/games/cricket/CricketScreen: UI for configuring and playing a cricket match, processing shot choices, updating match state, and recording results in user stats.
frontend/src/games/ludo/LudoBoard.tsx: Renders an interactive SVG Ludo board, computing piece coordinates and handling piece selection per player.
frontend/src/games/ludo/ludoRules.ts: Defines Ludo game state and rules including movement, captures, dice rolls, and win checking.
frontend/src/games/ludo/LudoScreen.tsx: Provides the UI for playing Ludo, managing game flow, dice rolls, piece moves, and updating user stats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, loading stored identities and exposing login/clear utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks for loading and saving the caller's user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: Hooks for fetching and updating authenticated users' game statistics through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, color variables, dark mode themes, and custom utility classes including arcade gradients and glassmorphism effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/screens/GameShell.tsx: Provides a reusable page shell with a header, back button, optional icons, and layout styling for game screens.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Renders the home screen with game selections, hero section, login button, and user-aware UI.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, color bindings to CSS variables, container settings, and animation utilities.
project_state.json: Describes the overall project state, features, requirements, image assets, and metadata for the game application.
